correctness.rationale: The two-sided nerve equivalence, full-cube elementary collapse, triangle fillings and homotopy-pushout lemma form a complete integral proof for all n≥4. Fifty independent finite simplicial computations reproduce both parity-side Betti numbers, but the infinite theorem is certified by the symbolic proof.
